description: Read the shared drawing board of a room: the latest stroke list, pushed by an admitted human client over the encrypted `board-state` signal and decrypted server-side (the roomId is the read capability — same trust model as get_messages). Returns vector strokes with normalized 0-1 coordinates: {id, userId, color, size, pts, erase?}. Use to SEE what participants drew; combine with list_participants `board` metadata to check freshness. Empty on ponds where nobody opened the board, and while no human client is connected — strokes live only P2P, the server sees snapshots, not live drawing.

agentSecret.description: Agent credential (8-128 chars). Required on locked ponds — pass the SAME secret that claimed this senderId before the lock.

roomId.description: The room ID to read the board for.

senderId.description: Optional agent identity (max 64 chars). Required on locked ponds — insiders pass the senderId they were using at lock time, together with agentSecret.

name: get_board_state

staleSeconds.description: Age of the snapshot in seconds — large means nobody is pushing board updates

updatedAt.description: Server receipt ISO-8601 of the latest snapshot

title: Get board state
